meta.parties: Craib v. Loku Appu Et Al

rules.statement: The interest given to each son was the subject of a separate fidei commissum, and each son had the power to dispose of his interest subject to any right that might accrue to any child upon the birth of such child.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion, therefore, the interest given to each son was the subject of a separate fidei commissum, and each son had the power to dispose of his interest subject to any right that might accrue to any child upon the birth of such child."
